question: Which permission sets and profiles show or hide this tab?

steps.name: tabs
steps.soql: SELECT Parent.Name, Parent.IsOwnedByProfile, Visibility FROM PermissionSetTabSetting WHERE Name = '{tab}' ORDER BY Parent.Name

verdicts.say: No profile or permission set has a setting for {tab}.

traps: Standard tabs are named standard-<Object>; custom object tabs use the object API name.
